title: Attuned To The True One, You Shall
summary: The shabad does not leave anger at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord
lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord; those who have served You with love are truly wise
source.lifeApplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.

evidence.coreClaim: Attuned to the True One, you shall obtain a place of honor in the Court of the Lord; those who have served You with love are truly wise
evidence.turn: Keep returning to this turn: Nanak lives by chanting and meditating on the One, who is pervading within and contained amongst all.
evidence.practicalImplication: Slow the tongue before you defend the self-image behind it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
